We're looking for a commercially driven Email & CRM Specialist to join a growing international ecommerce business, taking ownership of email marketing and CRM across its UK and US markets.
This is an opportunity for someone who knows how to make CRM deliver commercially. We're looking beyond simply building and sending campaigns. We want someone who understands customer behaviour, knows how to use data to identify opportunities and has the technical expertise to turn those insights into increased revenue.

- Take ownership of email marketing and CRM performance across UK and US markets.

- Drive commercial performance through improved conversion, revenue per recipient and customer retention.

- Analyse campaign and Flow performance, identifying gaps and opportunities to improve results.
- Produce meaningful performance reports, translating data into actionable commercial recommendations.
- Work closely with Ecommerce, Trading and Creative teams to align CRM activity with product launches, promotions and trading priorities.
- Continuously challenge existing processes and identify new ways to improve customer engagement and revenue.

What we're looking for
- At least 3 years' experience in ecommerce email marketing or CRM.
- Strong hands-on experience with Klaviyo, including campaign management, automation, segmentation and reporting.
- Proven experience building and optimising automated customer journeys and behavioural Flows.
- Strong analytical ability, with the confidence to interpret data, identify trends and make commercially driven decisions.
- Experience developing and implementing A/B testing strategies.
- A strong understanding of ecommerce customer journeys, conversion and retention.
- Someone who can identify when something isn't working and confidently recommend how to fix it.
- Commercially minded, proactive and comfortable taking ownership.

Desirable:
- Experience with Shopify, GA4, Yotpo and SMS marketing.
- Experience working within a product-led ecommerce business.

What makes this opportunity different?

You'll have genuine ownership of a key commercial channel within an ambitious, growing ecommerce business.
This isn't a role for someone who simply wants to send more emails. It's for someone who wants to understand the numbers, challenge performance, experiment with new approaches and make a tangible difference to revenue.

title: Wellbeing Co-ordinator (12 Months FTC)
description:
An exciting opportunity has arisen for a Service User Wellbeing Co-ordinator to join our Domestic Abuse Service for a 12 month FTC to cover maternity leave. You will be joining a multi service charity based in Coventry. In return, we offer a competitive salary of £29,093 per annum, plus on-call payments and a contributory pension scheme. Annual leave 26 days + bank holidays with an additional day s leave for every 2 years of service up to a maximum of 29 days per annum. We also have a comprehensive in-house training programme.

What We Do:

The charity has a fully trained staff team providing Supported Accommodation and support to victims of domestic abuse. There is also an on-site Children s Nursery that provides full day care for pre-school children.

We are looking for a reliable and committed individual who is able to:
- Work closely with staff and Valley House domestic abuse service users to create a groupwork programme aimed at promoting positive health.
- To provide a range of groupwork and learning and development activities designed to support our service users to achieve positive health and wellbeing outcomes.
- Consult with staff and service users to identify a range of groupwork activities and interventions that will support service users to improve their health and wellbeing.
- Develop and deliver the programme across Valley House services.
- Identify and engage with partner agencies, leading to partners delivering groupwork activities for our service users as part of the programme.
- Monitor and evaluate the impact of the groupwork sessions, creating reports as and when required.
- Use the evaluations to continually improve the programme, using examples of good practice as appropriate.
- Support service users to co-deliver activities as appropriate.
- Be part of the on call rota.
- To provide 1-1 wellbeing support to service users.
- Promote and safeguard the welfare of children and vulnerable people that you come into contact with as part of your role.
- Ensure that Child Safeguarding and Safeguarding Adult Procedures are followed as necessary and to liaise with statutory agencies and attend inter-agency meetings as required.

The successful candidate will have:
- NVQ Level 3 in a related field and/or a minimum of 3 years relevant experience with survivors of domestic abuse.
- Experience of developing and delivering groupwork programmes.
- Experience of partnership working.
- Knowledge and understanding of health and wellbeing interventions and how to effectively promote them.
- Knowledge and understanding of the difficulties faced by survivors of domestic abuse.
- Knowledge of best practice in relation to safeguarding adults and children.
- Understanding and passion for the work of Valley House.
- Ability to work effectively within a team and on own initiative.
- Ability to work flexibly.
- Competent in the use of IT tools, including Word, Excel and Outlook.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Additional requirements:
- To take part in an out of hours on call rota with other staff.
- Be mobile and able to travel city wide at short notice (car driver with use of a vehicle).
- Candidates who are not car drivers, due to a disability, will be considered.

This post require a satisfactory DBS check.

This vacancy is open to women only (exempt under the Equality Act 2010 Schedule 9, Part 1).

The hours of work are 37.5 hours per week.

The closing date is Monday 14 December 2026 and interviews will be held on Friday 18 December 2026.

title: Workwear Coordinator
description:
Workwear Coordinator

Salary: 30- 33k per annum depending upon experience

Status: Temporary to Permanent

Hours: Monday to Friday (Apply online only)

Location: Coventry & Warwick

Are you an organised, customer-focused individual who enjoys being out and about, building relationships and delivering exceptional service?

We are looking for a Mobile Workwear Coordinator to join a fantastic team, supporting the delivery of a managed workwear service across multiple locations throughout the Midlands and one site a week in Liverpool.

This is a varied, hands-on role where you will be the face of the business on-site, ensuring associates receive the workwear they need, when they need it, whilst providing an outstanding level of customer service.

Working across multiple sites, you'll take ownership of workwear distribution, orders, customer enquiries and garment requirements, helping to ensure everything runs smoothly and efficiently.

You will not be on your own! This is a dual role working with a colleague and a fabulous Contract Manager.

The Role

You'll be responsible for:
- Collecting and delivering workwear between customer locations and company facilities.
- Delivering garments to designated lockers across various sites.
- Processing workwear orders accurately and efficiently.
- Handling customer enquiries and resolving order-related issues.
- Managing garment returns, exchanges and replacement requests.
- Tracking orders and proactively informing customers when garments arrive.
- Supporting the Finance team with invoice queries where required.
- Maintaining accurate records of orders, deliveries and customer interactions.
- Building strong relationships with associates, site contacts and colleagues.
- Maintaining company vehicles, equipment and work areas safely and professionally.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for someone who is naturally organised, proactive and customer-focused, with a positive attitude and the confidence to work independently across multiple locations.

You'll ideally be someone who:
- Enjoys face-to-face customer service and building relationships.
- Is highly organised and able to manage competing priorities.
- Takes ownership and proactively resolves problems.
- Remains calm and professional under pressure.
- Is adaptable and happy to support a variety of operational activities.
- Can work independently whilst being a strong team player.
- Takes pride in delivering exceptional service.
- PC Literate
- Ideally a clean driving licence, no more than 6 points

The Business

You'll be joining a family business that genuinely values its people, its customers and the quality of service it delivers

If you're someone who enjoys being hands-on, meeting people, organising your day and making a genuine difference to the customer experience, this could be an excellent opportunity for you.
